name: CH32V307V-EVT-R1
description: Cheap (~$11) RISC-V4F evaluation board for the CH32V307: 144 MHz, USB HS, 10M Ethernet, 8 UARTs and on-board WCH-Link for debugging and download.
notes: The R1 version includes the WCH-Link (the older R0 does not). Sold mainly through LCSC, PCBX, AliExpress and eBay rather than a WCH store; prices run about $9-17 and LCSC is often out of stock. The CH32V307 offers up to 480 KB flash in some configurations; the MCU entry lists 256 KB.
CNX Software notes 8 UART ports; the CH32V307 has USB HS with built-in PHY and a 10M Ethernet PHY. USB connector types, size and the exact set of on-board connectors were not verified from a manual.
